title: Agent state per pane from Claude Code hooks, answered from the manager list
notes: A hook script posts permission_prompt, idle_prompt, agent_needs_input and agent_completed to the app. Main keeps a state per pane, keyed by an environment variable the app sets at spawn. The manager row shows the state and the question text; a key on the row sends the answer to that pane. Bell detection stays as the fallback for shells that are not Claude Code.

comments.body: From main-dashboard: much of this may exist already. workerSettings (src/main/workers/dispatch.ts) installs Notification (permission_prompt to 'blocked'), UserPromptSubmit and PostToolUse notify hooks, and #294 added stop notices with the last message and pane report. Check what is left first: the manager row showing the state and question text, and a key answering from the row. Build only that, following keyboard-first and the help rule. If nothing is left, say so on the card. Do not bump the version.

Hooks per pane, the asking row and bell fallback already existed. Built the gap: a Claude-screen worker's manager row printed its hidden shell and typed keys went there. Now the row shows the question with numbered answers and a digit answers it (main too). PR #302.
Pull request #302 opened: Answer a Claude screen's question from the manager row https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/302

Converged, ready to merge. Review loop: 3 rounds, 7 findings fixed, 0 rejected (c610ab4e, 02f399ef, abbeb805), after main was merged in to clear a board-card conflict (c0e778cd). Then main-dashboard's safety check (8fa48152): a digit on a manager row allows a tool call only when the row shows the call itself (tool + command/path/URL, every command line kept, cut with …). A plan, an agent or an MCP call takes no digit and is answered on the screen. manager-decision-3, chat-row-call.ts with a test. CI green on 8fa48152. The final nit fix (README rewrap) had no re-review.

f4a2c086: a call cut to fit the row's 160 characters is printed cut but takes no digit, so a dangerous tail hidden behind the … cannot be approved from the manager. Tested with cd x && <harmless> && rm -rf ~. CI green on f4a2c086. Still ready to merge; not reviewed by a loop round, not checked by hand.

3b697aaa merges main again (#298, #301). One conflict, in docs/manager/decisions.md: kept main's new paragraph on restoring the manager's workers and kept manager-decision-3. Typecheck, lint and 3311 tests pass. Full CI on 3b697aaa: 5 of 5 pass. Mergeable, ready to merge.
